decision_rules: Source-identity research can close while exact coordinates, Catholic eligibility, media and publication approval remain separate.
A shrine devotion does not create a distinct sanctuary building; named sites and buildings must be independently corroborated.
Do not conflate a basilica, chapel, complex anchor, monument, or urban procession starting point.
Negative candidate-country matching is not definitive proof there is no existing site; no automatically generated IDs.
Do not rewrite or erase the original P12 decisions; P13 is an append-only delta.
